prompts.text: Name a movie involving time travel.

items.quip: Its Omega 13 device rewinds time by exactly 13 seconds.
items.title: Galaxy Quest
items.extract: Galaxy Quest is a 1999 American satirical science fiction comedy film directed by Dean Parisot and written by David Howard and Robert Gordon. It stars Tim Allen, Sigourney Weaver, Alan Rickman, Tony Shalhoub, Sam Rockwell, and Daryl Mitchell. It follows the cast of a fictional cult television series, Galaxy Quest, as they are drawn into a real interstellar conflict by aliens, who think the series is a documentary and have shaped their society around the show. The film parodies and pays homage to science-fiction films and series, especially Star Trek and its fandom.

prompts.text: Name a country where French is an official language

items.title: Vanuatu
items.extract: Vanuatu, officially the Republic of Vanuatu, is an archipelagic country in the Melanesia region of Oceania located in the South Pacific Ocean. The archipelago, which is of volcanic origin, is 1,750 km (1,090 mi) east of northern Australia, 540 km (340 mi) northeast of New Caledonia, east of New Guinea, southeast of Solomon Islands, and west of Fiji.

prompts.text: Name a brand with an animal in its logo.

items.quip: Honors founder George Hurst, who died in an elephant hunting accident.
items.title: Tusker (Vanuatu beer)
items.extract: Tusker is a lager produced in Port Vila, Vanuatu, by Vanuatu Brewing Ltd. It is one of the most popular beers in the country and is often considered the national beer of Vanuatu.

items.quip: Carnegie Mellon calls its bagpipe degree program the world's first.
items.title: Bagpipes
items.extract: The bagpipe is a woodwind instrument using enclosed reeds fed from a constant reservoir of air in the form of a bag. The Scottish Great Highland bagpipe is well known, but people have played bagpipes for centuries throughout large parts of Europe, North Africa, West Asia, around the Persian Gulf and northern parts of South Asia.

items.title: Eulachon
items.extract: The eulachon, or the candlefish, is a small anadromous species of smelt that spawns in some of the major river systems along the Pacific coast of North America from northern California to Alaska.

prompts.text: Name a job where people wear a uniform.

items.quip: Sumo's two top referees wear a dagger, symbolic readiness for seppuku.
items.title: Gyōji
items.extract: A gyōji  is a referee employed by the Japan Sumo Association, responsible for a variety of activities which concern the organisation of the sport in general and the refereeing of matches, as well as the preservation of professional sumo culture, deeply rooted in Shinto traditions. Subject to the same strict hierarchy and traditional appearance as the other professions gravitating around professional sumo, the gyōji are one of the most visible professions at tournaments, being the third person in the dohyō and sometimes defined as "an essential part of the sumo spectacle".
